reason: A DeepSeek integration plugin that retrieves and displays account balance details in the conversation header with manual and three-minute automatic refresh.

summaries.zh: 在对话页头部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额及充值、赠送明细，并支持手动和每三分钟自动刷新。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance, topped-up funds, and granted funds in the conversation header with manual and three-minute automatic refresh.

capabilities: Reads a configured DeepSeek API key from host-side credentials
Calls the DeepSeek user balance API
Displays account balance and balance breakdown in the conversation header
Refreshes balance data automatically every three minutes
